title: Sad Violin
blurb: Maximum pathos, minimum stakes. The melodramatic string melody exists purely so that something faintly unfortunate can be treated as a Shakespearean tragedy — a dropped ice cream, a missed bus, a gamer dying to the least dangerous enemy in the game. That mismatch has been a cornerstone of ironic editing since the YouTube montage era and shows no signs of exhausting itself. The trick is to play it entirely straight and let the strings do the sarcasm. Never funny when the misfortune is genuinely significant, which is a useful line.
origin: The classic ironic-tragedy backing track from the YouTube montage era.
